data.name: Riku
data.gender_notes: Riku is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Riku is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rik', which means sun. It is a unisex name that signifies a little sun or a shining one. In Hindu mythology, the sun god is revered as a symbol of power, energy, and intelligence. Therefore, the name Riku represents these qualities and is considered auspicious for both boys and girls.
data.spiritual_meaning: Riku is a name that embodies the divine qualities of the sun god. It is a reminder of the inner light and intelligence that shines within each one of us. It is a name that inspires us to bask in the warmth and energy of the sun, and to shine brightly in the world.
data.etymology: Riku belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Little Sun, Shining One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Riku total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

Riku as a name represents these qualities and is often considered an auspicious name for both boys and girls in Hindu culture.

In Hindu mythology, the sun is considered a powerful symbol representing energy, light, and knowledge. The name Riku is believed to imbue the qualities of the sun god and represents the inner light and wisdom of the individual bearing the name. It is said that those named Riku are blessed with the strengths of the sun, including courage, radiance, and intelligence.
